reply.text:
Think of it as getting ready to take a punch. Take a breath in through your nose and push it down into your belly, so your midsection expands 360 degrees, not just your chest. Then brace your abs against that air as if someone were about to hit you, and keep it locked while you descend and drive back up.

Set the brace at the top before you unrack or start down, and don't let the air leak out until you're past the sticking point. For heavy sets, reset the breath each rep at the top.

A common mistake is sucking the belly in or flaring the ribs up. Keep ribs stacked over the pelvis and push the abs out against the brace, not in. If you want, send a video and I can open a form check.
